why: One new pure helper whose behaviour is spelled out step by step, one replaced line in runJobs() that matches cron-runs.ts:117 exactly, and five fake-timer unit cases plus two int cases that pin the peak, the throwing job and the hung job. No money, data or permission is touched, and the jobs themselves and tracked() stay as they are. A pool that is subtly wrong shows up at once as late or failing jobs on the platform home, and reverting it is one line.
harm_if_wrong: Dispatcher jobs would run late or one hung job would delay the round, which the cron health screen shows within minutes.
brief_problems: The docs sentence has a three-way fallback (platform.md, then docs/rules/budgets.md from step 0.43, then docs/capacity.md) that depends on another step's file; harmless, but it is a choice the cheap model has to resolve.
